# UPLOAD YOUR TAPE [italic]Five easy steps. Step four takes six to nine weeks.[/italic]
## STEP 1: RECORD Any camcorder will do. Point it at something interesting. Keep your thumb off the lens. Tapes longer than one cassette must be sent as a series.
## STEP 2: LABEL Write your channel name, the tape title and your colony on the label in block capitals. Tapes labelled DO NOT WATCH will be watched first.
## STEP 3: POST Hand the tape to your colony mail office, addressed to YouTape Sorting, Ring Two, Gateway Station. Postage is paid by the sender. Tapes posted from {colony} are carried on the next supply run, if there is one.
## STEP 4: WAIT Your tape travels to Gateway, is copied by our technicians and is sent out on the relay. This takes six to nine weeks. If your tape was recorded before a hypersleep journey, it may arrive before you do.
## STEP 5: REWIND Your tape is live. Tell your bunkmates on [netlink="MyBunk" link="mybunk.social"]. Every rewind counts as a view.
## WHAT WE WILL NOT COPY - Tapes of restricted Company sites or Company property, including your own office, which is Company property. - Tapes of animals that do not appear in the Colonial Fauna Register. - Tapes that are only screaming. We get more than you would think. - Tapes that arrive without having been posted. Please stop sending us those. We know you are not sending them.
